name: 92688 · Rcho Sta Marg, CA
findings: ZIP 92688 (Rcho Sta Marg) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92688 (Rcho Sta Marg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
